_comment: Copy to fleet.config.json (gitignored if it names private infrastructure) at your repo root or pass --config. Paths are relative to the repo root. Every value here is an example.

apps.name: example-desktop
apps.notes: Electron tray app, no Docker — skip Docker/Prisma categories

apps.name: example-cots
apps.notes: Third-party images only: grade currency, exposure, secrets — not first-party standards

floors._comment: Set from the vendor security page / OSV, never from memory. 0.0.0 disables the check.

shared_auth_core._comment: Optional, off by default. If apps vendor a shared auth file, set enabled: true and quick-checks diffs each copy against the source.

accepted_risks.reason: Profile-gated public reverse proxy, never started by default
